The Flood Detector System using Arduino is created to be one of the quickest strategies to monitor flood and Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the most important technical trends, which is utilized to monitor flood and human made resource to help in predicting and detecting essential events like flood, fire, gas and water leak that can position an threat to human life.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of MongoDB vs Cassandra in big data analytics
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In recent years, huge data is generating which needs large distributed databases to handle this massive amount of data. In general, relational databases were popularly used for many applications as it contains some rich set of features and transaction management capability. Yet, they are not efficient for storing and processing Big Data. Also, rapid growths happening in database models as these traditional relational databases are not capable to handle such vast data volumes. As Relational databases have several drawbacks, the requirement of novel technologies has emerged, that motivates developers migrate to Not Only SQL (NoSQL) databases. The key aim of this study is to make a review on capability of data storage and read/write performance in MongoDB vs Cassandra.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Aided Prediction of Building Structure Anti-seismic
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The application of artificial intelligence in the traditional industry has a broad prospect, in recent years, has made many achievements. The combination of artificial intelligence technology and various specialties in the construction industry to make corresponding expert system, decision support system and intelligent aided design will surely bring technological progress and comprehensive economic and social benefits. Because of the strong abruptness, high destructive power and high degree of casualties of earthquake disasters, it will not only damage the urban buildings and infrastructure construction, but also pose a huge threat to the personal safety of the audience. Therefore, in the process of modern construction, it is necessary for construction enterprises to pay attention to the seismic performance design of the overall structure. In this paper, a new method of structural reliability evaluation is proposed, which uses artificial intelligence technology to reduce the subjectivity of evaluation. Due to the fuzziness of the understanding of the structural reliability, the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is used to evaluate the reliability. According to the current appraisal regulations, the structural system is divided into three levels: component, sub unit and appraisal unit. Firstly, the membership degrees of components for different reliability levels are obtained by trained neural network, and then the membership degrees of sub units and appraisal units for different reliability levels are obtained by multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Review on Compressors based Approximate Multipliers Design
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This article gives the information based on design of various approximate multipliers along with the applications. For the design of approximate multipliers, some suggested compressors consisting of planes with different certainties or accuracies are taken into consideration. These multipliers can be compared with some of the characteristics like lesser delay, smaller area, and less power consumption in order to get the final good yield. Based on these parameters any kind of multipliers can be designed. Here the different compressors like 4-2 compressors, 5-2 compressors, compressors based on area efficient and high speed are discussed in this review paper. Also, the applications of approximate multipliers are discussed. Some of the applications include error-tolerant, image processing, structure of JPEG encoder etc. Finally, the article will be going to discuss on the possible constructs of compressor and the determining the inaccuracy which can be used for better design issues.

articleTitle: Determining the optimum TMS and PS of overcurrent relays using the Firefly Algorithm for solving the relay coordination problem
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: To determine optimal solutions, Artificial intelligence (AI) was used to a number of problems by evolutionary search and metaheuristic algorithms. They are being used in numerous problems related to modern power systems, such as economic load dispatch and coordination of relays. Overcurrent relays (OCRs) coordination is a major issue in the distribution system (DS) protection. To minimize the overall operating time of the relays and set the optimum values of the relay, the coordination should be done correctly. Make sure that when a fault happens, the least damage is incurred. The application of the firefly algorithm (FA) for optimal coordination of relays is presented in this paper. Using MATLAB, the algorithm was implemented and evaluated upon various systems, two of which are discussed in this work. The obtained results by the firefly algorithm (FA) and genetic algorithm (GA) are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on Student's Performance based on Health status using Genetic Algorithm and Clustering algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Data analysis is the emerging research field that relies on methods and techniques to make insights on the data sets. Data analysis on student's academic Performance based on their Health status such as nutritious food intake, hygienic life style and frequency of health issues is the main objective of the research. The datasets were obtained by Questionnaire method and the analysis were carried out initially with clustering algorithms such as K-means algorithm, Hierarchical clustering and EM Method. In the second phase, Genetic search was performed and the outputs were generated. The statistical output representation for the important attributes are given using orange software. The algorithmic Experimental setup was also carried out with weka datamining tool on student's dataset that has 113 instances and 93 attributes. The findings of the research work were that K-means algorithm outperformed well when compared with EM method and Hierarchical clustering. Genetic search method predicted correlated attributes for the selected class attribute and the outputs are generated. The statistical data analysis shows that nutrition and health issues of female students has an impact on the academic performance of students.

articleTitle: Hybrid Classfication for Heart Disease Prediction using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In general, data mining is considered as a method utilized for mining the valuable data from the available rough data. The futuristic outcomes are forecasted by utilizing the recent information in the prediction analysis. This research work deals with heart disease prediction. The proposed research work introduces several steps for heart disease prediction. The RF and DT based hybrid scheme is introduced and later the features are abstracted using RF. The implementation of DT is done for classification. The performance analysis helps to acquire accuracy, precision and recall of the recommended model. The proposed model has obtained an accuracy of about 94.44%.

articleTitle: Covid detection in CT and X-Ray images using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Coronavirus disease is an infectious disease therefore its early detection and diagnosis is important. Currently used methods take a long time and are not precise. Computed tomography (CT) and X-rays can be used to detect coronavirus. Manual evaluation of CT scans and X-rays requires expert knowledge and are time consuming. In this paper, the authors have proposed a max voting-based ensemble learning approach for Covid detection. The state of art models used in ensemble learning are InceptionNet, ResNet and EfficientNet. The combined dataset of CT scan and X-ray is used for training and testing. The proposed approach achieved sensitivity = 98.18%, specificity = 96.6%, accuracy = 97.47% and area under curve = 95.36%. These achieved results signifies the utility of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Star Shaped Antenna for Ka Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, a fractal based microstrip patch antenna has proposed for the dual band operations and at the same time it is mainly designed for Satellite communication and the applications in Ka band frequency with low profile, light in weight, easy to fabricate and high flexibility. The antenna consists of a fractal rectangular patch with microstrip line feed etched on a Rogers RT5880 substrate. This antenna is designed by using fractal technology because it has better input impedence matching, operates at multiband. Instead of using many antennas only one antenna can perform over huge frequency range with miniaturization. The fractal technology used here is Koch snowflake formed by displacing the middle one-third of each straight segment by some fraction called indentation width. By using Fractal technology miniaturization of antenna, better matching of input impedence, consistence performance over huge frequency and higher bandwidth is achieved. This antenna can be operated in Ka band which has a frequency range from 27 to 40GHz.The simulations of the proposed antenna is done by Ansoft HFSS version 13.0.

articleTitle: Analyzing Software Effort Estimation by Applying Static, Single & Multi-Variable Models
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: One of the indispensable parts of Software Project Management is to estimate the size of the software. The predominant advantage of doing this exercise is that it cooperates with project managers to forecast the overall effort, development time, productivity, and manpower required to complete any project; to a great extent. For this computation, assorted measures are being applied by industries. In this paper, software size estimation practices are examined on two different models as SEL model and the W-F model. Five different projects that are developed in different programming languages are taken as an input to these models. Further, computation of estimation and related analysis has been presented.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Various Digital Modulation Schemes based on Bit Error Rate under AWGN Channel
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century most of the technology works is on digital mode whether it's AI or digital communication. Digital signals require modulation for transmitting data from one place to another. There are many techniques available for modulating digital signals but the most commonly used are Binary Amplitude Shift Keying (BASK), Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) and Binary Frequency Shift Keying (BFSK). These techniques are selected on the basis of factors like low Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), low Bit Error Rate (BER), complexity of design and final cost of the product etc. This paper will focus on the performance comparison of theoretical and simulated BER of above three schemes and then comparing the BER of all three schemes in same conditions and predicting the best technique for digital signal transmission. The simulation is done in the MATLAB software.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Methodology in Fog Environment for DDOS Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The Distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack pose a great threat to a heterogeneous network like Internet of things (IoT). The loss to a firm caused by a DDoS attack is directly proportional to the duration of the attack so it is important to identify and mitigate the attack as soon as possible. The traditional architecture of IoT has three layers consisting of the end device in the bottommost layer, controllers in the middle layer, and cloud in the uppermost layer. Any kind of decision-making is done in the cloud so the whole process is slowed down due to latency delay. We have adopted the architecture of a fog layer with sufficient computing power above the end device layer. We have used two deep Learning-based models. First long short-term memory (LSTM) model to identify the malicious data from the benign data and second convolutional neural network (CNN) model to further classify the data into attack categories. Our lstm model has an accuracy of 98 percent and cnn model has an accuracy of 86 percent.

articleTitle: Automated Billing Smart Trolley and Stock Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this modern world, all people like to use products which is of high technology. People do not want to waste time and energy by using conventional systems. Rather they prefer advanced devices which is automated, smart, to finish their work soon. Smart trolley is one such advanced devices which is more flexible and a easy process to complete shopping without any delay. Customers in the store do not want to wait for long time to pay their bill. In the smart trolley the bill can be paid simultaneously without waiting in the counter. Once the shopping is over payment is done through online or offline based on the customer. This flexibility is not provided by the existing trolley. To overcome this, Smart trolley is preferred. The newly designed smart trolley consists of Arduino UNO, RFID reader and tag, Wi-Fi module. Apart from this payment feature, smart trolley allows the admin to view the stock details also. Each product’s stock can be monitored and planned accordingly without any extra manual work.

articleTitle: Design and validation of CAN protocol with enhanced Security in electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Controller Area Network(CAN) which is specially designed for Automotive connectivity has a major drawback in the security of data transmission, where the data can be easily hacked. By hacking the data can be read, altered or even false data can be injected which will lead to a huge risk for the vehicle itself and the driver/passengers in the vehicle. To prevent this combining two algorithms in cryptography (AES and RSA) encryption to the messages in the CAN bus is provided. The data sent from the ECU will be encrypted using the AES algorithm, the key used by the AES will also be encrypted using the RSA algorithm. Decryption will be done by a reverse process where first the key of AES will be decrypted and then the data will be decrypted. By providing encryption and decryption the data can be transferred securely. This project also provides authentication which is achieved by sending acknowledgment signals. By providing encryption and authentication the Replay attack and Injection of forged frames can be avoided. Here the time taken for encryption, authentication, and decryption for different samples of the text of different sizes are also calculated. Results shows that proposed algorithm is more suitable for e-vehicle with better CAN protocol security.

articleTitle: Chaotic Grasshopper Optimization with Wavelet Kernel Extreme Learning Machine for Medical Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Medical data classification acts as a vital part to enhance the survival rate of the patients and control the health condition to a certain level depending upon the clinical and non-clinical profiles of the patients. To improve the survival rate and decision making process in healthcare sector, necessary disease diagnosis models become essential. This paper presents an efficient Chaotic Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (CGOA) with Wavelet Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (WKELM), called CGOA-WELM for Medical Data Classification. The CGOA-WKELM model involves preprocessing at the beginning stage to raise the data quality. In addition, WKELM based classification process gets executed which involves the weighted approach to cost function for obtaining the identical effects of weighted ELM. At the same time, in order to effectively set the parameters of the WKELM model, CGOA is applied as a parameter optimizer in such a way to enhance the classification performance. An extensive experimental validation process gets executed to determine the betterment of the CGOA-WKELM model and the results are investigated interms of distinct aspects. The attained experimental values verified the superior performance of the CGOA-WKELM model on all the applied three datasets.

articleTitle: The Impact of Corona Pandemic on the E-Commerce Industry Using Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, the world got introduced to a new respiratory system attacking virus called “Coronavirus”, causing a disease called "Covid-19". As this virus is very contagious and spread through physical contact that may be the pathway for the virus into the lungs, people started practicing social distancing. As a result of this pandemic situation, many businesses and social places met a great loss and many of them had to shut down. But on the contrast, people who are maintaining strict quarantine tend to be more online centric. So now, the main question is whether this pandemic brought good fortune for the e-commerce industry of Bangladesh or the complete opposite. There have been no research regarding this topic ever before, let alone answering aforementioned questions. So, this research work decides to conduct an elaborate research using Data Mining on that matter inside the geological area of Bangladesh. This research answers most of the questions about the relation and effects of the “Corona pandemic” situation with the newly growing e-commerce industry of Bangladesh.

articleTitle: Recent research progress of computer science and technology and its application in intelligent art analysis systems
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Recent research progress of computer science and technology and its application in intelligent art analysis systems is studied in this paper. According to the functions of computer networks, logically speaking, its main purpose is to transmit effective information and to connect general various computer systems through the communication lines to then form the good computer network information transmission system. Inspired by the recent work, the fuzzy clustering, neural network and the convex optimization are considered to construct the evaluation system for the intelligent art analysis. The advantages and drawbacks are jointly studied. The designed model is efficient.

articleTitle: An Extensible Framework for Sentiment Analysis based on Opinion Disambiguation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is an extremely well-known application territory of text mining. Deep Sentiment disambiguation is a significant piece of any sentiment analysis or assessment analysis of text mining. This paper chiefly centers around cyberhate order, since the spread of disdain discourse by means of online media will problematically affect social union and lead to territorial and local area strains. The proposed structure tends to the test of an ongoing investigation of Social Media posts and the recognition of self-destruction-related conduct and the cyberhate cycle. To handle the flood of a person's online substance, execute a Fuzzy structure for the order of text, which is generally utilized for the recognition of changes in information stream settings. The contribution to this system is a progression of conduct highlights registered from every Social media post.

articleTitle: Quality of Transmission Improvement in Underwater Wireless Sensor Nodes using Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The quality of transmission in underwater sensors are more challenging due to unidirectional transfer across depth to the surface. In this scenario, the energy remains in some nodes wherein some consists of drained energy in close proximity driven by transmission. Hence, confining transmissions by appropriately selecting nodes in particular area via compressive sensing improves the quality of transmission. In this work, quality of transmission underwater wireless sensor nodes compressive sensing (QTUWSN-CS) model is proposed by considering the topology and data flow nature. The reconstruction accuracy along the deployed terrain is bisected in such a way that the demands of traffic and its quality of transmission are preserved.

Author Keywords: Number of transmissions in underwater sensors

articleTitle: Self Healing Memory Using 2D Spares
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Test cost and yield enhancements are the vital parameters as the memory capacity and density increase. Built-in redundancy analysis (BIRA) is primarily used for incorporated memories to resolve yield and quality by replacing faulty cells with available cells. Various BIRA approaches need different area overheads to achieve optimal repairs. It is not easy to get low area overhead along with optimal repair rate. A novel BIRA method is proposed that requires less storage for storing faulty address information by deleting the data of unimportant faulty cell addresses. The proposed BIRA examines redundant spares quickly to achieve optimal repair rate. Simulation results show that the proposed BIRA does the spare allocations efficiently.

articleTitle: Real-World Simulation Through Obstacle Avoiding Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Technology advancements are now reaching new levels for instance, Tesla’s auto-drive, auto-mobile, and so on. It can identify obstacles on its own and thus can automatically avoid them. Now scientists and engineers are working more towards the advancement of this technology. Autonomous robots are used everywhere nowadays and robotics is additionally gaining popularity all around the world. This motivates us to make an autonomous Robot. Similarly, our project is also related to self-obstacles avoiding technology. It also includes the des ign and development of an autonomous robot that is s mart enough to sense and avoid hindrance of its path. The machine is set up using electronic sensors and programming languages, so that the s mart robot can be navigated to monitor in real-time. This model can be implemented using a python programming language. As a result, an autonomous robot is designed to monitor the objects using a virtual screen.

articleTitle: Human-computer interaction evaluation model of software system based on grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Human-computer interaction evaluation model of software system based on grey fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is designed and implemented in this manuscript. Due to the continuous acceleration of the unification of multimedia and information in the new era, the interpersonal interface of mobile terminals has more reflected user experience and user emotional factors. This paper hosts the 2 aspects of innovations. (1) The signal strength helps people to conduct faster and more comfortable human-computer interaction while reducing mobile devices. (2) The electronic information interaction software is then designed based on the cloud computing model, the grey system is validated. The experimental results prove the results.

articleTitle: Integration of Indoor and Outdoor Voice Based Navigation Detection using Light based Communication (Lifi) & IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Global Positioning System [GPS] has always established a tracking application, which is similar to the implementation of actual smartphones. Even though, the existing system holds this feature but on the other hand the door navigation has its own complication because of the utilization of portable devices used in different events. This includes location based application and other features which are becoming a research priority. Whereas in the proposed system there is integration done between the indoor and outdoor navigation by tracking through Wi-Fi technology. Here, for establishing the indoor navigation Wi-Fi is utilized and when the person is out of range of the Wi-Fi network then GPS comes into the range for sharing the location. The modification done in this project provides additional features such as voice based input, which will be useful for the blind for their navigation and this improves the efficiency of the project.

articleTitle: Network Information Security Pipeline Based on Grey Relational Cluster and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Network information security pipeline based on the grey relational cluster and neural networks is designed and implemented in this paper. This method is based on the principle that the optimal selected feature set must contain the feature with the highest information entropy gain to the data set category. First, the feature with the largest information gain is selected from all features as the search starting point, and then the sample data set classification mark is fully considered. For the better performance, the neural networks are considered. The network learning ability is directly determined by its complexity. The learning of general complex problems and large sample data will bring about a core dramatic increase in network scale. The proposed model is validated through the simulation.

articleTitle: Unknown Terrain modelling using 3D mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Exploration of unknown terrains to learn the geographical significance of the place plays a major role in making new discoveries that may lead to new inventions and better understanding about Earth. At times, it may be dangerous for humans to explore the terrains in person. The objective of this project is the creation of a 3D map using Unity platform dynamically and simulating it. This project uses a single robot which will help to reduce the dangers of cave explorers and archaeologists by creating a simulated map of the unknown terrain using 3D mapping in unity. The Master bot traverses and scans the area by moving periodically with an equal distance using an encoder, and then the values are transmitted wirelessly to a host machine. Thus, the values get parsed at the host machine and the data is retrieved. The 3D position and surface reflectance generated can be viewed as an image. The delay between scanning and mapping of the terrain is less than 2 secs. Thus, this bot can be used to explore unknown terrains cost efficiently and reliably.

articleTitle: Communication Mode of Computer Cluster Network in Cloud Environment based on Neural Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Communication mode of the computer cluster network in cloud environment based on the neural computing is analyzed in this manuscript. Cloud computing can make full use of virtual technology and effectively combine many clients and workstations into a whole to form a virtual computing laboratory which will enhance the efficiency from a large perspective. Before the generation of distributed storage backup in cloud computing environment, the data storage backup method based on the computer server is usually more miscellaneous, which is to increase its storage backup space by improving its scalability, so as to meet the requirements of related application functions of data packet storage and upload. Hence, this paper provides the novel perspectives of the network communication model. The test shows that efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Image feature extraction and analysis algorithm based on multi-level neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Image feature extraction and analysis algorithm based on multi-level neural network is studied in this paper. As a research direction of machine learning, deep learning method has been widely concerned. This method obtains more abstract and effective high-level semantic information by combining low-level features to discover different feature representations of data. This research work aims to design the model based on the multilevel neural network with the implementation of the feature extraction pipeline. The core of deep learning is feature learning, which aims to obtain the hierarchical feature information through a hierarchical network. The framework is validated through the image processing. The proposed algorithm is simulated on on the public database, and the result is efficient.

articleTitle: Efficient Virtualization in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In the era of Internet technology, Cloud Computing plays a vital role in research. The main purpose of cloud computing is to transport the resources and services on the user's demand. To run an organization successfully, it provides flexible infrastructure and easy method of handling a massive data. To improve the efficiency of cloud computing virtualization role is crucial. Firstly, this survey has studied the introduction and cloud computing evolution with fundamental properties. Section three describes the service and deployment-based models and section four shows virtualization and its approaches. Section five focuses on advantages and disadvantages of cloud computing. After all section six concludes the article.

articleTitle: Composition of Online Teaching and Academic Ability under the Background of Artificial Intelligence and HTML
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the performance of intelligent devices, the continuous improvement of HTML5 and related technologies, and the rapid de velopment of mobile social applications such as wechat and Sina. A variety of innovative, well-made mobile HTML5 advertising has entered the public eye. HTML5 advertising on the mobile terminal combines the characteristics of mobile intelligent devices, and brings the audience audio-visual enjoyment, emotional and spiritual interactive experience. Autonomous learning has been attached great importance to college teaching. With the continuous improvement of the level of science and technology, network teaching has gradually penetrated into the actual teaching environment of colleges and universities. The teaching contents of network teaching courses and open courses in Colleges and universities fully reflect the important value of network teaching. Artificial intelligence technology will have a broad and far-reaching impact on the education system, and promote the overall reform of the teaching system. This paper analyzes the influence of artificial intelligence technology on education, and then clarifies the elements of teaching system and the relationship between learning methods and learning resources in the era of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: A Survey on Detection Approaches of Shilling Attacks in SAN
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In social Aware Network (SAN), the major exercises focus on investigating the behaviour and properties of the consumer. This examination of consumer trademark helps in the plan of profoundly productive and appropriate conventions. Specifically, the peddling assault presents a serious level of weakness into the recommender frameworks. Proposal System is an uncommon kind of data sifting framework adjusted by online merchants to give suggestions to their consumer dependent on their necessities. Collective sifting is quite possibly the most generally utilized suggestion frameworks; lamentably, it is inclined to peddling/profile infusion assaults. Such assaults modify the suggestion interaction to advance or downgrade a specific item. Throughout the long term, numerous assault models and recognition strategies have been created to moderate the issue. This paper means to be an extensive review of the shilling attack models and discovery calculations. Likewise, this research work momentarily examines the late works in the advancement of strong calculations that reduce the effect of pushing assaults. This paper likewise presents potential gain and disadvantage of every one of the inspected papers with its various sorts of identification approaches and execution measurements.

articleTitle: SIW Cavity-Backed Ultrawideband Cirularly Polarized Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A new design of substrate integrated waveguide-based cavity backed slot antenna for ultrawideband application is introduced in this paper. This new circularly polarized Bow-Tie slot antenna is taken for circular polarization in ultrawideband frequency band (9.65 GHz to 10.26 GHz). The proposed slot radiator is designed using a single substrate having height of 0.787 mm, which make this radiator low profile, easy integrable with other circuits and cost effective. The proposed antenna is designed using two cross bow tie slots etched at the bottom metallic conductor and coplanar waveguide feed on the top conductor. The radiation characteristics of the proposed cavity backed broadband bow-tie slot radiator is better than traditional cavity backed slot antenna. Slot radiator backed by SIW cavity were taken because of its high gain and better front-to-back ratio. At the resonating frequency the designed prototype shows a bandwidth of 0.1227 GHz (12.27 %), gain of more than 5 dBi. For the complete half-power beamwidth, the axial ratio is found to be below 3 dB.

articleTitle: Method of Enterprise Information Software System (EISS) Monitoring Based on Grey Analysis and Data Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Method of enterprise information software system (EISS) monitoring based on grey analysis and data clustering are jointly discussed in this paper. The application of management information system in enterprise management should bring convenience to enterprise management, but also bring higher efficiency to enterprise management. This paper focuses on the 2 aspects of novelties. First, preprocessing in data mining is mainly to extract the task-related knowledge sources and conduct legality checks. The proposed research work adopts k-means and BP neural network to construct the efficient data processing model. Second, comprehensive evaluation model will be based on automatic evaluation, supplemented by the manual evaluation based on the k-factor. The proposed model is used to evaluate the performance of the proposed framework. Through the analysis of simulations, the performance is verified.

articleTitle: A Coherent Hybrid Precoding for homogenize Millimeter-wave Multiple- in Multiple- out Systems for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In the present scenario, most of the communication systems depend upon MU-Millimeter Waves. A high gain beamforming has been achieved by using millimeter wave communication system. A group of antennas used at transmitter and receiver-end for providing better throughput and efficiency is called massive multiple input multiple-output (MIMO). By using this technique, a better spectral efficiency, throughput, power efficiency and also low bit error rates can be achieved when it is used along with the fifth generation mobile networks. Multiple number of antennas are used at the transmitter and receiver end instead of single antenna. The interference and multipath propagation problems are the major disadvantages in communication systems, which can be resolved in this technique. Through multiple antennas transmission of data is done as it is taking multiple different paths because of obstacles in the environment to make the system more efficient at the receiver antenna the best received signal is processed. To overcome signaling overhead complexity efficient signal processing techniques have to be used at both the ends. To resolve path loss MIMO is furnished with millimeter wave bands. To achieve high spectral efficiencies which requires less cost and to consume low power precoding of hybrid analog/digital is used. At transmitter end and receiver end large antenna arrays are deployed to provide required signal power which makes the architecture for millimeter-wave systems more complex. Hybrid precoding is an attractive architecture for millimeter-wave systems. It focuses on narrowband channels. A union of digital and analog precoding which is a hybrid precoding is preferred to achieve less complexity and better performance. To take the advantage of beam forming gain and spatial multiplexing in millimeter wave system hybrid precoding is exploited for more frequency chain. An inter user interference is nullified at analog step. The transmitting data rate is maximized at digital step. The proposed work, Hybrid Precoding is preferred is to estimate digital precoding for eliminating inter-user interference basing on solving convex optimization problem. By using more base station antennas more directive gain can be distributed to large number of users. Bit error rate and spectral efficiency is improved for 100 paths.

articleTitle: Preprocessing Phase of Text Sequence Generation for Gujarati Language
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Within India, many languages are spoken as well as used as a communication platform in day-to-day life which represents the basic requirements to be able to generate NLP based functionalities in different Indian languages. Text processing of digital content has experienced a great expansion process in recent years in the development of innovative technologies that develop new content of information in a very quick and understandable form. This paper presents a survey on various text sequence processing challenges like Word Sense Disambiguation, Part of Speech tagging, Named Entity Recognition in the Gujarati Language. It is an Indo-Aryan Linguistic originated from Sanskrit. Text Process generating each word in the corpus corresponding to a specific part of speech to text conversion like noun, verb, adjective, pronoun, adverb, conjunction, etc. It is a very critical task and preprocessing moves for entire natural language processing behaviors. There are many challenges part in text processing like ambiguities reduction, foreign text detection, stop words and annotation task finding, etc.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Dual-Band CPW fed Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This manuscript proposed a dual band Co-planer fed (CPW) microstrip antenna having two bands resonating at 1.8 GHz and 5.2 GHz with each band exhibits a bandwidth of 1.2 GHz. The detail parametric analysis, on varying the various parameter linked with the antenna, is done to optimize its performance. It is observed that the optimization of bandwidth and return loss together is a challenge. There is a trade-off between bandwidth and return loss to get the best design for antenna. This manuscript, based on parametric analysis, not only best design for the antenna with dual bands of almost equal bandwidth and return loss is proposed, but also some other interesting observations are concluded. Finally, the best design is fabricated and characterized. A close agreement is observed between experimental and simulated bandwidth and return loss.

articleTitle: Expert based Recommendation system using Community detection in Online Music Streaming services
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Recommendation systems utilize methodologies such as collaborative filtering and content based methods to make recommendations to users. Content based methods are based on similarity between item attributes and collaborative methods calculate the similarity between interactions. This paper proposes a new methodology for making recommendations. Recommendations are made on the basis of the choices that experts belonging to a particular community make.Communities of users are determined using the Louvain method. The results obtained suggest that each community listens to multiple musical genres. Most communities listen to `universal genres' (e.g. pop music) and are differentiated by the number of listeners of less `universal genres' (e.g. reggae). Nodes within a community that have the highest degree centrality are deemed experts. The choices made by an expert in a particular community are served as a recommendations to other users within that community.

articleTitle: Cognitive Analytics of Apple Products from Crowdsourced Tweets
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Human cognition is stimulated with the nature and structure of our brain. The emotions expressed by the humans are heavily dependent on the brain-stimuli. The product manufacturers are showing their keen interest to know the feedback from the customers about the products. In the Internet-era, the customers are sharing their views, opinions, reviews in publicly available resources such as Online Social Networks (OSN). These reviews have correlation between their mood or emotion and the time at which the customer express their review comments in such platforms. This research is focused on identifying the emotions, as human cognition, which are expressed in a crowdsourced-tweets of Apple products. The dataset used in this research has sentiment values based on the customer reviews. Moreover, the dataset was crowdsourced to mention whether the review belongs to the Apple company or not. It is being found that there is a significant difference between the results available in the sentiment values and the results obtained by this research – cognitive analytics. It is also noted that though the sentiment values are high for some of the opinions, whereas the emotion values are neutral. The novelty of this research is to map the opinions to the eight different human cognition and also to finally find whether the opinion is positive or negative.

articleTitle: FPGA Architecture To Enhance Hardware Acceleration for Machine Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Many algorithms have been developed in the field of Machine learning and its sub-fields such as neural networks, Deep learning and so on, for applications such as pattern classification, image and video processing, statistical data mining and so forth. These algorithms perform such tasks with remarkable accuracy. However, when implemented in traditional processor core software, many of these algorithms get choked when the size of the network or computational demand of the algorithm scales up. FPGAs and ASICs offer higher computation capability, throughput and bandwidth. Features such as massive parallel processing, high performance and reliability, are strong arguments for FPGAs for Deep Neural Network applications. FPGAs offer reconfigurable, flexible architectures where even the most popular GPUs fall short. This paper proposes a robust, re-configurable architecture for deploying Machine learning algorithms and presents its advantages by implementing a Neural Network in an FPGA and comparing its results with an implementation in a Raspberry Pi.

articleTitle: A Review on Data Mining and Machine Learning Methods for Student Scholarship Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This review paper consists of literature survey to prediction of scholarship by using Machine Learning and Data Mining technique. Along with this it contains a small description of ML/DM which are used by the researchers. It also describes data sets as very important in ML/DM methods. Machine Learning becomes most popular in the field of IT industry. Nowadays Machine Learning and Data Mining turn as a powerful technique which applicable for various fields such as IT, Education sector and also in business sector too. The different types of ML/DM algorithms are addressed by using all this technique. The algorithms which give more accuracy results in detection of continuity of every student's scholarship such as Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree and k-NN. Finally, the proposed model will provide a list of candidates, who deserve to have a scholarship and also discussion has been made on accuracy of each techniques which was used to get a result.

articleTitle: A Brief Review on Methods for Classification of Medical Plant Images
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Plants on earth play a significant role both in human and other lives. Plants have the greatest influence in the nature cycle. Plant identification in biology and farming is very demanding, as new plant discoveries and plant computerization are more well established. For a broad range of uses, including environmental conservation, plant resource assessment and education, automatic plant classification systems have to be implemented. The leaves are considered the way medicinal plants are characterized. The automated identification of plant species using photographic leaves is an interesting objective, as biodiversity decreases rapidly in the current mix and taxonomists lack properly trained. The identification of the right plant is the most critical step in the preparation of the medicine that is carried out manually. The identification of these plants is immediately relevant because of demand for mass production. The physical and mental health of human beings is crucial for medicines. For better care it is important to identify and classify medicinal plants. The lack of experts in this area makes it tedious that medicinal plants are properly identified and classified. A fully automated system is therefore highly desirable for medicinal plant classification. This article provides a brief survey of the various models for identifying medicinal plants by taking into account the form and texture of a plant leaf.

articleTitle: Collaborative Innovation of Online Ideological Education Platform with Data Mining and Text Recognition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With modern rapid and emerging development trend of Internet technology, great number of data are accumulated in the society, which leads to a larger data scale. With the target to discover the potential value of general data, it has been usually necessary to flexibly apply various data mining algorithms based on the actual situation and scenarios. The implementation of data mining algorithm is faced with great challenges in terms of execution efficiency, algorithm parallelization and platform usability. Different from horizontal text, multi-directional text and curved text, the surface text of surface object has some geometric features. In the detection phase, the text box label of surface text needs more vertex coordinates to express its spatial information, which makes it difficult to label large-scale samples. In the recognition stage, it is more difficult to recognize the surface text of the surface object than the regular text on the plane. At present, several universities ignore the importance to the construction of political education micro platform, and fail to develop a scientific micro platform according to the actual needs and interests of students. Based on this situation, this paper applies the data mining models and text recognition algorithm to study innovative smart political education platform.

articleTitle: Tennis Assistant Referee System based on Intelligent Sensor Network and Data Understanding
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Tennis assistant referee system based on intelligent sensor network and data understanding is designed in this paper. These integrated sensors perceive, collect and also then monitor the information of the target object through mutual cooperation. It is essential while dealing with the data complex issues. In order to improve the tracking accuracy of the model, the method of multi-granularity feature is used to judge the tracking result, and with the tracking model, the assisted model is considered. The experiment compared with state-of-the-art ones have proven the efficiency and the QoS performance.

articleTitle: Image Captioning with Attention Based Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Defining the content of an image automatically in Artificial Intelligence is basically a rudimentary problem that connects computer vision and NLP (Natural Language Processing). In the proposed work, a generative model is presented by combining the recent developments in machine learning and computer vision based on a deep recurrent architecture that describes the image using natural language phrases. By integrating the training picture, the trained model maximizes the likelihood of the target description sentence. The efficiency of the model, its accuracy and the language it learns is only dependent on the image descriptions, which was demonstrated by experiments performed on several datasets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques in Plant Conditions Classification and Observation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Earlier identification of plant diseases is very important as it may adversely affect the growth of their respective species in the near future. Generally, plants are believed to be a more essential resource for both human beings and animals. Furthermore, the plant disorders will affect the leaf. Along these lines, the area of plant affliction expects a significant field work. Regardless, it needs more human force, additional time to analyze the subtleties on plant sicknesses. Then, Artificial intelligence [AI] is used to characterize the microorganisms in plant leaves as it dismembers and orchestrates the information from completely different perspectives into one of the predefined set of arrangements. For course of action, other morphological options and properties, for example, concealing, power, and estimation of the plant leaves are considered. Henceforth, this paper presents an outline of altered assortments of plant illnesses and different gathering measures in AI, which are utilized in various plant leaves for identifying infections. The trial results demonstrate that, even with an exactness of 96.7 percent, the utilization of adjusted AI techniques could be successfully utilized for the grouping of different plant leaf illnesses. This technique would be very useful for the ranchers to maintain a strategic distance from crop harm, the absence of food creation in the public arena and the misuse of cash on farming items. For example, pesticides and so forth.

articleTitle: Design of 6.7 GHz ˜ 7. 518 GHz Cross Coupled LC-VCO in 180nm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper discusses the analysis and design of LC VCO in 180nm CMOS technology with 7 GHz resonating frequency using Cadence Virtuoso environment. The designed circuit works at 1.8 V supply voltage. VCOs are the main component of PLL that is used in the generation of IR pulses in UWB systems. The designed LC - VCO with a bandwidth of 6.711 GHz - 7.518 GHz is to be used in the IR-UWB system that generates short pulses using indirect IR-UWB method. The gain K of LC VCO designed was 484 Mhz/V. The output power P (mw) was 2.25mw. The observed Phase noise at 1MHz is -103.2dbc/Hz and at 10 MHz is -131.5dbc/Hz. The resonating frequency was verified using PSS analysis, which gives a resonating frequency of 7 GHz. The FOM of the designed VCO is - 136.98 8 dbc/Hz.

articleTitle: Securing of Cloud Data with Duplex Data Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Data Outsourcing and Data Backups is controlled solely by means of external agencies so as to decrease the cost for information administration. Data Protection is the major challenge in public clouds where there is no proper security mechanism followed, so to access data or store data in cloud, the administrator first checks the authentication of user. Proposed system provides Cryptographic tool by utilizing a combination of RSA, AES algorithm and set of rules to accomplish a secure sharing of information. Our convention is based totally upon an association of cryptographic key additives which is exempt from any external cloud administrations.

articleTitle: IoT based Noise Detector with Automatic Recording System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Talking loudly is an infuriating habit in an office environment as well as in industry the machine noise is quiet annoying. The office environment with loud co-workers can distract the work and reduce the work efficiency. The machine noise in an industry environment above 85dBA affects the hearing capacity. To help and solve this issue, a noise detector with instinctive recording device is proposed. This device informs the user about the noise level and whenever the noise level exceeds the limit, it automatically records the sound and its duration. This system finds wide advantage for labors in industry, which provides frequent warning information to the user if the noise limit exceeds.

articleTitle: Machine Learning approach for Inverse Kinematics in Trajectory Planning of Pioneer 2 Manipulator with Cubic Spline Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The primary objective of robot manipulators is to achieve the desired orientation and point of end effector in order to accomplish the pre-established task. Inverse kinematic analysis will be used in the pioneer 2 robot to obtain a successful solution to design and operate the arm. This paper considers a 5-dof revolute Pioneer2 manipulator which is compact, low cost and lightweight. When the DOF of the robot increases, the inverse kinematic problem becomes more and more complex and gives n number of joint configurations for the same position. This results in making the standard solution for this problem becomes trickier. To overcome the computational complexity of kinematic analysis of Pioneer 2 robot, the objective of this study is to perform intelligent computation of inverse kinematics with the use of machine learning techniques that consists of linear regression, K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm and Artificial Neural Network. By comparing three algorithms R-square values and RMSE values, it is observed that KNN algorithm is giving better results. Therefore, KNN can be used for better solution of inverse kinematics with fast results and high accuracy. Then the smooth trajectory is achieved using cubic spline interpolation.

articleTitle: Cloud-Scope: A Modern Patient Monitoring and Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The current technique for checking patients in hospitals keeps patients attached to their beds and can be awkward for patients to wear. The quantity of medical caretakers in the labour force is additionally expected to decrease by 2020, causing strain in a climate where overabundance pressure can prompt stress mishaps happening to patients. The objective of this project was to deliver a remote patient monitoring and future analysis framework that could permit patients to be versatile in their current circumstance. The created framework incorporates a heartbeat oximeter to gauge blood oxygen fixation and the patient's heartbeat, just as a temperature sensor to monitor the patient's temperature. Other physiological boundaries, for example, internal heat level, breath rate, and anomalous heart beat through Heart rate sensor and so forth these physiological boundaries are level changed over and communicated through UART directly fetched to the cloud. The objective of the proposed module is to screen the boundaries adequately through Thing Speak IOT platform and dependent on basic qualities, the ready framework is created to give alert on crisis conditions. The patient monitoring system designed here not only used for monitoring purpose also developed a software module to control the limitations and data collected from the patients are further fetched to analyse the critical happenings based on the pattern of abnormality.

articleTitle: Comprehensive report on Homomorphic technique in Healthcare Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper aims to study and analyse the homomorphic technique that is used for data security in edge and fog computing in the healthcare domain. The main purpose of this paper is to gain more knowledge on how holomorphic technique is for data security in edge and fog computing in the health care domain. The proposed research work observes how medical records and data values are kept safe and formulated using newer technologies such as fog computing and edge computing. Using a simple and convenient method a descriptive statistics was collected on how much of this homomorphic technique is used in the health care domain. A total number of 200 medical records were collected from 5 reputed hospitals and medicals clinics, out of which 110 were female patients’ records and 90 were male patients’ records. Although, there were 200 on a total, all 200 were considered as samples from the different hospital servers used for the research. It gave results of 95% accuracy and security while using a homomorphic technique in data security in edge and fog computing. Since, these two advanced technologies are utilized in this research and it also demonstrates the homomorphic technique for data security using different homomorphic devices. Among all the 200 records collected 95% of patients assures and accepted the fact of high security in their medical records by using homomorphic technique in edge computing and fog computing. Finally, the proposed research work has been concluded with a discussion on various parameters such as the significance, pros and cons of using homomorphic encryption in the medical domain and the results on implementing homomorphic technique for data security.

articleTitle: Evaluation and analysis of the beauty of fine art paintings based on image feature recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Evaluation and analysis of the beauty of fine art paintings based on image feature recognition is studied in this paper. In the image retrieval, the traditional Euclidean distance measure is used to initially detect the query image set that meets the image retrieval conditions. The traditional clustering method of categorizing pixels only uses the gray information of the pixels, while ignoring the spatial location information, hence feature recognition is combined to enhance the model. The image estimation model is integrated to validate the robustness. In the experiment section, the ideas are validated through the analysis. Compared with the latest models, the proposed algorithm has the better performance.

articleTitle: Home-School Collaborative Smart System Based on Video Transmission and Information Compression
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Home-school collaborative smart system based on video transmission and information compression is designed and implemented in this paper. Therefore, designing an objective and accurate video quality evaluation method that can be run online is of great significance for improving the performance of the congestion control algorithms. The novelties of the paper can be focused on following aspects. (1) SSIM is generally recognized because of its ease of the calculation and high accuracy in characterizing subjective perception. The channel coding model is used to improve the accuracy. (2) Data security and also privacy protection is an important service provided by edge computing. This factor has been considered in the IoT system design. The proposed framework is compared with the related models. The evaluation results shows the performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Interpretation of Sino-Japanese Intercultural Communication based on Network Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Intelligent interpretation of smart Sino-Japanese intercultural communication based on the network information processing is studied in this paper. Distributed multi-spatial data exchanges information in the cyberspace through wireless access services and also cloud computing technology. The proposed method considers the data collected for analysis. Deep learning is a part of the machine learning, which is a method based on data representation learning in machine learning. The deep learning model is used to finish communication work. The experimental work demonstrates the satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Design of New Media Marketing and Intelligent Broadcasting Framework Based on Cluster Computing Internet System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Design of new media marketing and intelligent broadcasting framework based on cluster computing Internet system is presented in this paper. Hybrid parallel computing for cluster computers is based on the clustering of the big data. This paper combines the novel data analytic framework to enhance the model. In the field of the IoT terminal security authentication, the security boundary set by the cluster architecture network is not fixed data, so in the process of IoT applications, hence, the IoT is integrated to construct the system. Further, the performance is validated through the experiment.

articleTitle: Modern Stage of Health Services in IoT Era
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) aids to connect devices and the internet for real-time processing. IoT has spread in all sectors e.g. automobile industry, agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare, retails, finance, transportation, and many more. It uses sensor-based technology to monitor various tasks. It makes the system efficient and has the potentials to provide the best service. This article will discuss IoT and one of the important aspects of today's life that is healthcare. IoT assures efficient services to the healthcare sector. IoT has made it possible to create an environment that is helpful for better services at the customer end and excellent concern at the staff end. For both prospective IoT is a boon. IoT is enhancing the use of data and analyzing stacks of patients that make services best as doctors to provide better prescriptions based on real-time data. This article highlights the advancement that happened in the medical sector and that makes the system efficient. IoT is becoming a helping hand but also becoming a matter of great concern in the medical world.

articleTitle: Theoretical Research and Framework Design of Spanish-Chinese Smart Translation System from Machine Learning Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Theoretical research and framework design of the Spanish-Chinese smart translation system from machine learning perspectives is done in this manuscript. Cyberspace has become the main virtual space of people's spiritual life. The main form of information in cyberspace contains pictures, and also image communication and image dissemination have become a new trend. To this, the machine learning perspective is applied for the construction of the smart model. A fuzzy information analysis model is established for the characteristic vocabulary translation, and combine related feature extraction and fuzzy information optimization control methods to realize online control of characteristic vocabulary translation. The machine learning algorithm is used to perform fuzzy control and convergence judgment on the online generation process of the featured vocabulary translation, and realize the optimization of the online generation process of featured vocabulary translation. The intelligent model is implemented through the analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Comparison of ACO and Fuzzy PID Controllers for Fermenter System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Fuzzy rule based PID controller and Ant Colony Optimization technique based PID controller is designed to control the concentration of the fermenter system. Over the past few years, the control of Fermenter has become significant due to their complex nonlinear nature. The conventional P+I+D controller tuning can result in severe process performance degradation, so that the conservative controller provides inadequate performance while controlling temperature and level control processes nonlinear dynamic behavior. Hence Ant Colony Optimization based PID controller is designed which is compared with Fuzzy rule based PID Controller to overcome the classical controller problems and provide better set-point tracking capability and improve the process's dynamic and stable performance. From the comparison with respect to the Error indices and Time domain specifications it is found that Ant Colony Optimization PID controller gives better result when compared to Fuzzy rule based PID controller.

articleTitle: Application of VR Technology in Museum Narrative Design with Computer Vision Models
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The establishment of a virtual museum is an epoch-making thing. Its conceptual development has gone through four basic core stages: exhibition, reconstruction, replacement and reproduction, hence, pplication of modern VR technology in museum narrative design with computer vision models together with the scenario test is provided in this study. Virtual reality technology is a high-tech computer science technology that combines multiple technologies, including computer three-dimensional graphics technology, computer vision and data analysis. This designed freamework applied the technology and the vision minotirng to the systematci design. The hardware implementations are also validated through the platform constructions. The test, comparison analysis and the efficiency testing are provided.

articleTitle: Smart Online University Party Building System Based on Association Rules Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Smart online university party building system based on association rules data mining is designed and shown in the paper. According to the need of data patching, the association rules related to the target attribute will be searched by reasonably reducing the value of support, that is, find the corresponding conditional functional dependencies. For enhancing the data robustness, the neural model is applied into the training stage of the model. Furthermore, the system is implemented through the platform design. The user interface and the experience are jointly improved through the test.

articleTitle: Data Analytics based Statistical Analysis of Air Pollution in the Major Cities of Karnataka
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Air pollution is the discharge of contaminations into the air that is damaging to human wellbeing and the planet. Air contamination is one of the big issues to deal with for any nation. In South Asia, they rank it as the sixth most risky killer. People won't realize the damaging outcomes of hassle if he/she has not experienced it. Pollutants comprising particulate matter (PM) or nitrogen dioxide (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) can cause respiratory ailments or cardiovascular sicknesses. World Health Organization tested that 11.6% of worldwide sudden demise may follow back to air pollution. The Air Quality Data is capable to perceive the patterns and identify correlating elements on key ranges of Air Pollution. To our knowledge, this analysis offers to deal with distinguishing a pollution source as starting from an individual area considering collected records. This gives a helpful strategy for air quality administration, and the outcome may be noteworthy to ecological and monetary issues. In this article, the air quality information of the Indian state, Karnataka were analyzed to find standards or styles which might deliver our perception into how extreme the trouble can be measured.

articleTitle: PIC Microcontroller based Automated Horticulture System for Farmers
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The proposed research work has developed a novel working model to assist the growth of plants by deploying enhanced protection and fully controlled environment. The horticulture environment data processed through the sensors play a vital role in enhancing the quantity and quality of the developed product. The manually performed assistance for plant growth is protracted and at the same time, it consumes more time. With the help of Internet of things and different sensors, the proposed system has been developed to play an important role in the development of plant and their production. The monitoring and controlling of plant is carried out with the help of DHT11, actuators, and water level sensor. Furthermore, the Output of these sensors are stored for further analysis while elucidating the concept of cloud instrumentation in the horticulture system.

articleTitle: Context-based News Articles Retrieval using CLSM
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the continuous growth of the electronic data and the expansion of World Wide Web, users are flooded with information for a single search query. Most commonly, the results that arrive for the search query ignore the context. Context has several dimensions such as users context, query/document context, spatial/temporal context. Though context is not a new idea in building intelligent systems, Contextual Information Retrieval is a biggest challenge in IR domain.This paper proposes news article retrieval using Convolutional Latent Semantic Model (CLSM). CLSM extracts the contextual features present in the query and finds the relevant documents and ranks them based on their relevance with the given query. CLSM was experimented with the clickthrough data of a commercial search engine and has been proven for its context-sensitive results and efficiency. In this paper, we discuss the feasibility of using CLSM for extracting news articles based on the context present in the query from a static news article repository.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Sports Guiding System Based on Agent Model and Video Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of China’s sports level, some universities, cities and enterprises have established large stadiums. Intelligent sports system provides conditions for people to exercise and host large-scale events. At the same time, the safety of stadiums has also attracted great attention of the country. Intelligent vision detection and tracking is a new research direction in the field of computer vision in recent years. Based on the computer vision method, the video data obtained by the camera is decomposed and learned, and then the video is detected and tracked. This paper uses time-frequency tracking technology and agent model to build an intelligent sports guidance system. Because agent has independence and encapsulation, it can encapsulate social attributes and parameters into agent. Then, a single agent is regarded as a node in the network, and an agent-based social network model is constructed. In this part, there are two parts: the design of agent model and the construction of network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of PLC based water Curtain Nozzle Controller for Warehouse Application
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This artile proposes a way for smart control of fireside spreading within the warehouses. Warehouse assets include a huge array of amenities intended for the storage of varied commodities. The warehouses may vary counting on the sort of materials stored. The extent of automation in the warehouse depends on the storage capacity, and the retrieval mechanism. Therefore, the height of stacking commodities is the prevailing fire safety system to predict on the structure of building and the space for storage. The factors considered for implementing fire protection in warehouse design are building area, height, the storage methods, and therefore the commodity also as local rules and regulations. It is not an easy task to propose a fireplace protection design for the warehouses with such variations. To incorporate of these factors, a PLC based water curtain nozzle control is proposed to avoid the fast-spreading of fireside in warehouses.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Multi-Tier Application by using the Comprehensive Workload Modelling in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Cloud-computing is the on-request accessibility of computer system-assets, especially data-storage and computing power, without client direct dynamic administration. Proponents similarly cloud computing ensures that ventures allow them to get more of their applications faster, more reasonably, with more rationality, and with less support, which empowers asset groups to quickly change assets to meet fluctuations and exceptional needs. The current framework centers around how to diminish the dynamic remaining task at hand and increment the reaction time prerequisites in the multi-application by utilizing the auto-scaling virtual machine cloud assets. The proposed framework is to improve the exhaustive remaining task at hand model which considers the space of the specific information document in the cloud for multi-level applications. The total framework uses the RDF Classifier model through which the Request Time and Average Response Time are determined. The proposed strategy plays out the auto-scaling utilization of the remaining task at hand conducted approach which assists with foreseeing application reaction time.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence System in Smart Education in Cloud Environment with Optimization Models
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Application of the artificial intelligence system in smart education in cloud environment with optimization models is studied in this research. As cloud computing is widely used in society, cloud computing has become the convenient and fast information equipment, hence, this technology is considered as a basis for the designed framework. The combination of the cloud computing and scientific research. Scientific research involves a lot of large-scale computing, and many research institutions do not have such a large-scale computing equipment. The designed model is tested on the scenario of smart education. The results will be applied to the real scenarios.

articleTitle: Rural E-commerce Investment and Financing Model Based on Blockchain and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Rural smart e-commerce investment and financing model based on blockchain and data mining is presented in this paper. Using intelligence analysis to prevent financial risks is not only an urgent expectation in the financial field, but also an inherent need for the development of the information science. Blockchain is a chained structure that combines data chunks in chronological order in a sequential manner and is a distributed ledger that is guaranteed by cryptology.
