The proposed model is simulated compared with the latest models.

articleTitle: Active realization of series inductor and shunt capacitor and their applications in electronically tunable wave active filters
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, wave equivalents of the series and shunt capacitors have been realized by using Voltage Differencing Current Conveyor (VDCC). The proposed VDCC based wave equivalent of the series inductor requires four active building blocks and nine grounded passive elements, whereas the designed shunt capacitor realization is based on only six active elements and eight grounded passive elements. The proposed wave equivalents of series inductor and shunt capacitor have been verified by realizing a Low pass and second order Band pass filter. The designed wave active filters exhibit electronically tunable behavior, which can be verified from the presented simulation results. For the simulation purpose, PSPICE environment with 0.18um CMOS technology has been employed.

articleTitle: Bat Inspired Technique for Effective Clustering in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are functioned by using battery sources. A lot of sensors in the network is collaboratively utilized for performing, sensing, processing, and communication. These tasks use additional energy and have an effect on lifetime. Clustering methodology provides a better solution for performing the data communication process which extends the lifetime. In this paper, a bat-inspired technique is presented in LEACH-C to select the suitable cluster head. The proposed methodology utilizes the echolocation performance of bats for balancing exploration and exploitation phases in the optimization process. The fitness function is computed by using residual energy and node distance. The proposed method is estimated with the performance metrics of a lifetime, energy consumption, and the alive nodes. The proposed methodology prolongs the lifetime and reduces energy utilization.

articleTitle: Nearest Neighbor Monitoring Mechanism for Efficient and Secure Data Aggregation in WSN Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The Internet of Things has observed tremendous growth in the last two decades utilizing wireless sensor technologies and as the number of smart devices and applications increases, the need for data collection and analysis data becomes increasingly difficult. In general sensor nodes are powered through batteries hence it restricts the efficiency of Wireless Senor Network. Data aggregation is a top-most mechanism for redundancy discarding and improvising the network lifetime. It also possesses various advantages which include minimizing the energy consumption, minimizing the network traffic. Furthermore, as sensor nodes are deployed in hostile averments and transmit sensitive information, designed networks are prone to various attacks. As a result, the focus of this research work is on designing and developing the Nearest Neighbor Monitoring (NN-SDA) mechanism to provide secure data aggregation in an efficient and secured manner. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism allows the nearest neighbour node to monitor and detect the malicious node. Further, the NN-SDA-mechanism algorithm is designed by adding the anomaly and detecting the malicious nodes. The NN-SDA mechanism is evaluated in terms of malicious packet identification rate, average energy utilization, and system throughput and the comparative analysis is performed with the existing model.

articleTitle: Prediction and Visualisation of Viral Genome Antigen Using Deep Learning & Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Generally, human samples contain different viruses and their structure tends to vary from sample to sample. Henceforth, identification and classification of human viruses remains as a major challenge. The infection will set aside some efforts to get completely adjust to the flow of human or creature, who remain contagious to the new host. This data can be important for establishing effective infectious prevention and annihilation. Currently, the protein data bank comprises of 40,000 proteins with complex structure (PDB). This extension of resolved structures gives valuable insights to the specific three-dimensional structure of a protein chain, the interaction of chains in quaternary complexes and the prediction of primary sequence structures. The three-dimensional structure of a protein is described by a protein feature. The protein activity can be predicted due to the structural similarities with other known proteins. These informed predictions.

articleTitle: Performance of Water Cooled Thermoelectric Generator System for Petrol Engines Using Ćuk Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Thermoelectric Generators (TEGs) are popular nowadays for their application in waste heat recovery from automobiles. 75% of the energy extracted from petrol is wasted as heat in an automobile IC engine. This emitted heat contributes a major part in increasing global warming due to the increasing amount of automobiles day to day. In this paper, a part of the heat wasted from the exhaust of a two-stroke petrol engine is converted into electricity and is utilized to charge the battery. The main purpose of this energy extraction and conversion is to cut down the amount of heat released from the automobile exhaust into the surroundings and thus encourage conscious use of energy. But one of the challenges in this conversion is that the output voltage and efficiency of a thermoelectric generator module are low for charging the battery. To rectify this, a Ćuk converter is utilized to boost the voltage of the TEG module. MPPT algorithm controller is also implemented to ensure maximum power extraction from the module at all times. In this paper, an attempt is made to cool the cold side of TEG using water flow rather than airflow. It is observed that the temperature difference between the hot and cool sides of the TEG reduces when water is used as a coolant and this significantly reduces the power output from the TEG when compared with an air-cooled system. Water-cooled TEG system output voltage does not reach the expected value and cannot be used to charge the battery. The comparison between an air-cooled and water-cooled TEG system is also done.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung nodules using Convolutional long short-term Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Lung nodule classification is a key process for early prediction of lung cancer. Automatic diagnosis of lung nodules from computed tomography images decreases the risk of misdiagnosis. Deep neural networks have recently made phenomenal progress in analyzing medical images. A convolutional long short-term (ConvLSTM) based classification model is proposed to distinguish malignant from benign nodules. The proposed model captures important morphological features found in the series of CT images using the Convolutional long short-term memory network, which is capable of understanding linearly related spatial features from three dimensional images. The efficiency of the proposed classifier is assessed by the accuracy, precision, sensitivity, and area under the curve (AUC). The proposed model outperforms LSTM and CNN classifiers with an average accuracy of 93%. As the ConvLSTM based classifier forgets the irrelevant data and keeps the essential information required for identifying cancer nodules, it could distinguish the malignant and benign nodules better than the LSTM and CNN model.

articleTitle: LI-FI based Industrial Safety Module
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Safety is one of the main aspects of the industry, specifically core industry. To minimize material loss and human health damage, a protection system along with a rapid communication system is necessary inside the industry. The primary objective of this work is to design a green environment monitoring system for industries using Li-Fi technology to provide secure communication, high data rate transfer, and a pollution-free environment. The traditional system of wired communication along with the Fixed Base station has not been so effective. In this proposed protocol, as a source for data transmission, light-emitting diodes are used and are favored as they have a longer life-time. Different sensors are used to track different parameters in an industrial setting and these sensors relay sensed information in terms of LED flickering using Li-Fi technology. In this work, the main aim is to focus on the detection of abnormal gases, fire, and unusual vibrations in the industries and transmitting this information to the workers using the Li-Fi transceiver. Various adversities hindering the workers and emergency information can be efficiently communicated using this technology. If the sensor senses a value beyond the predefined threshold value, information is sent through text and alarm to the workers. The developed system surpasses most current systems as it provides communication at a rate of 1.5 Mbps with a range of 10 meters and, more importantly, is free of electromagnetic interference. Henceforth, the visible light communication (VLC) technique is exploited for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Collaborative innovation of online smart ideological education under the computer integration background
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Collaborative innovation of modern online smart ideological education under computer integration background is presented in this manuscript. The dynamic task allocation mechanism is the core service provided by the cluster system. Its function is to allocate tasks according to the total number of online computing nodes and computing processes based on the load balancing mechanism. Based on this structure, this paper designs the novel framework. Since the cluster platform does not have a limit on the number of the scheduling times, repeated scheduling of abnormal job subtasks will significantly increase the scheduling load, hence, the data analytics model is introduced to construct the framework. Later, sharing supported by CSCW is based on system knowledge management. Users' access shared data in the server group in the general CSCW environment through applications, the online framework is designed and the evaluation is based on the data analysis. The results compared with the latest system shows the performance is nice.

articleTitle: Implementation of High Speed and Low Power CAM with ML Sensing Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Content addressable memory (CAM), is a peculiar type of memory device and it is employed in high speed execution. Main feature of CAM Includes Pipelining in which it can search overall memory during a single click cycle. Unlike RAM, it's much faster altogether search executions due to its pipelining nature, but it demands quite high power consumption. Therefore, a high speed and low power Matched line sensing Amplifiers (MLSA) are extremely coveted for the designing of an effective CAM. The Simulation results using Cadence tool shows that the Parity bit technique is best suited to reduce the time delay by 60.36%. A closed loop feedback is introduced in Power Gated ML Sensing Amplifier to prevent the power being consumed further, thereby diminishing the power consumption by 49.81%. The designed CAM is commonly used in real time applications like look-up tables, databases, and, with this improved power and delay functions, these executions become appreciably worthwhile.

articleTitle: Investigation of Machine Learning Assistance to Education
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Machine learning as customized learning and teaching can help access student’s background, aptitude, learning speed and feedback of individual and cumulative performance based on different factors to the teacher. Currently, in the times of a worldwide pandemic, everything from schools to online exams and offices has been shifted to the online platform and served as a channel in continuous functionality that is necessary for development and subsistence. It can be seen in the education sector, especially in Higher education that by continuous working, integration of academics and technology has started, despite several limitations. This paper discusses how Machine Learning is expanding it’s root in education sector as well as the pros-cons that will be generated by the machines using intelligent technology.

articleTitle: A Study on Ensemble feature learning for material recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Recognition of variety of materials that is present in our surroundings plays an important role in wide variety of applications like robotics, material-based product search, image editing for interior designing etc. Hence it is necessary to propose a system to automatically recognize the material recognition. The different category of materials includes all kinds of fabric, foliage, glass, leather, metal, paper, plastic, stone, water and wood. This paper studies and compares knowledge-based classifiers with ensemble classifier to achieve automatic material recognition. The comparison study is carried on open datasets such as MINC-2500 dataset. Initially, the pre-processed input images from the training set are then fed to VGG16 and ResNet50 network. Machine learning models such as linear SVM, logistic regression and random forest are trained on top of these extracted features to obtain a classifier that can recognize the classes of materials. The experimental results exhibits that the ensemble feature learning of SVM and logistic regression through ensemble voting classifier achieves higher recognition accuracy of 80.05% than the traditional knowledge-based classifiers.

articleTitle: Edge Detection with different Parameters in Digital Image Processing using GUI
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)

authors.preferredName: V Y S S SUDIR PATNAIKUNI

abstract: Edge Detection is one of the most popular techniques in image processing, where it finds the boundaries of objects in an image. Edge detection place a vital role in different areas like image processing, computer vision, and machine vision for image segmentation and data extraction etc., Edge is nothing but a change of intensity in an image, whereas edge detection is a technique in which the image is divided into different regions of discontinuity. The proposed research work finds the edges of different digital images by using different operators like Sobel, Perwitt, Roberts, Log, and Canny have compared images by considering different parameters like MSE, PSNR, SNR and found that the Canny operator is the best for edge detection as it is a multi-stage operator, where it detect edges at the same time and it removes noise from the image. Along with its edges, some of the applications using edge detection are considered. Matlab GUI is utilized for further analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Histogram Based Resolution Enhancement of an Image by Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: High resolution (HR) images have more information about images than low resolution (LR) images. HR image can be more easily recovered from multiple low resolution images than the single LR image. Several LR images hold diverse details and can be dubbed together to get a HR image. Reconstruction of HR image using single LR image with fewer details remain more challenging. This paper proposes a neural network based model to increase the resolution based on feature extraction from a single image. Each LR and HR image is divided into smaller blocks and the histogram as a feature is calculated for each block. Back propagation neural network [BPNN] is used for learning of histogram features of LR image. The simulation has been performed on a dataset of brain MRI images and results show that the obtained neural network model has improved the PSNR and RMSE.

articleTitle: Automated Component/Equipment tray Access System (ACEAS) for Real Time Control
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In recent years the development in technology has reached to a greater extend, where complete automation has been implemented in all places. With all of these revolutions, technology has also made our lives easier, faster and, better. In this work, an automated smart compo-equip tray has been designed which contains all the components, apparatus, equipment and wires required to perform the experiments. An identity card (Id-card) with barcode has been given to all the students for accessing the components in-order to perform the experiment. While taking the components/apparatus from the container the student has to scan their Id-card which keeps the track. In addition to it, LEDs are used to sense whether the components are replaced back and also its initial and final weights are noted in-order to avoid missing of components and apparatus. Thus man power and time can be reduced by implementing the proposed system.

articleTitle: A Method to Compensate Reactive Power in Double Fed Induction Generator based Windmill using STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Recently, Doubly fed Induction generator is getting improved due to its advantages like variable, speed and autonomous controllability of both active and reactive power. In general, voltage stability problem and grid side disturbances occur in DFIG. The proposed research work uses integrative wind farms along with grid. Engineers have to follow grid codes and integrate the DFIG based wind farms into the grid as this research work recommends the connection of static synchronous compensator that compensates the reactive power and rectify the voltage stability problem and helps to protect the DFIG based wind farm form disturbances when it interconnects with the power grid. Here, MATLAB is used to simulate the proposed system results. The final result provides theoretical analysis of STATCOM to improve the stability and performance.

articleTitle: Improving Cloud Integrated Sensor Network Architecture, Applications & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network applications are applicable in so many significant areas like human health care observations, defense monitoring, environment observations infrastructure monitoring and so on. There are lots of issues & challenges like security, scalability, storage, network lifetime etc. in wireless sensor network. To overcome the issues & challenges, Sensor Cloud (SC) become significant element of nowadays research era. Sensor cloud is the combination of two individual technologies in one form. So, as far as concerned with fabulous data collecting capabilities of wireless sensor networks and because the powerful data storage and process capabilities of cloud computing, Sensor Cloud integration is now a days attracting increase focus from both academic purpose and industry purpose. Virtualization is key concept of Sensor Cloud in which more than one application simultaneously executes on every sensor device. For monitoring and controlling a number of applications, Sensor Cloud provide us open, flexible, and adjustable platform. Here focus on important discussion regarding Sensor Cloud Architecture which will give us sensor cloud design, applications, issues & challenges. The proposed research work discusses regarding social sensor cloud in which an algorithm is designed for both parameter energy efficiency and security through virtualization. The proposed research work will help academicians as well as industry persons for design and development of sensor cloud.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Similarity based Single Document Summarization
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In current days, there is an enormous amount of information available in various resources like www, e-books, tweets, several articles, and social media posts. Human beings have very little time available to them, whereas they must obtain the necessary information from these resources due to public and business requirements. Text Summarization is one of the solutions to this problem. It is a process of shortening the length of text present in the document computationally and permit to obtain the most vital information in a very less amount of time. Therefore, a similarity-based framework is suggested to summarize a document concerning various similarity measures. Document Understanding Conference (DUC) dataset is considered for empirical validation of the model.

articleTitle: Model of Enterprise Information Software System (EISS) Based on Grey Relational Modelling and GANs
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Model of enterprise information software system based on grey relational modelling and GANs is studied in this manuscript. The gray condition is added to the generator present in the deep convolutional generation confrontation network and it utilizes the ability of convolutional network to extract features plus conditions to supplement training. The model is designed and implemented using coding theory. The information software system is improved by adding the prior information and the basic training steps. Through the analysis of the real-world application, the performance of the model is validated.

articleTitle: Techniques for Electing Cluster Head to Prolong the Network Lifetime in WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Interest and research in the field of Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) has been on the rise since the last two decades owing to its applications in day-to-day life. Wireless Sensor Network consists of a large number of inexpensive and tiny devices called sensor nodes, which help to monitor many remote environments such as forest, habitat, vehicle tracking, etc. These sensor nodes have the capability of communicating with each other using wireless techniques i.e., controlled by routing protocols. Based on the network category, WSN is divided into two types, i.e., "flat network and hierarchical or cluster-based network" [1]. Cluster-based network has many advantages like energy efficiency, good network communication, and better topology system. Clustering algorithm plays a vital role it selecting an optimal cluster head to have effective transmission of data. This cluster head act as a unique node for each cluster in the network which helps to transmit data using less energy consumption. This paper has focused on clustering and cluster head (CH) selection techniques and its parameters which help to reduce energy consumption and to prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Fiberoptic Oceanic Sensor to Measure Oceanic Parameters with Marine Instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed the increased research interest on the ocean ecosystem, since it is majorly required to sustain the other ecosystems. This paper discusses about the fiber optic oceanic sensor and its introduction to the technology-driven world. Furthermore, the propose research work has attempted to design an oceanic fiber optic oceanic sensor, which can measure the required parameters of ocean ecosystem. Also, the fluid dynamics and other processes are also considered, while designing the process of our sensor. This sensor will later on be tried with Fiber Bragg Grating, which is also a fiber optic sensor. The oceanic trials of this sensor have been attempted in the konkan coast.

articleTitle: Switching based Single Input Multi Power Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this modern era of electronic technologies, all the appliances require a separate power supply. To overcome this drawback, the concept of a single converter with multiple power supply has been proposed. Furthermore, the proposed research work clarifies about multipurpose charger, which alters and uses a boost topology to supply different outputs as required for different applications. Proposed method consists of multiple PWM duty cycles to produce multiple regulated power supply voltages, and so it is also referred as multi power boost converter. It uses one converter for obtaining various outputs. For example, mobile, laptop, electric vehicle, or any other electronic appliances can be charged using multi power boost converter.

articleTitle: Analysis on Telemarketing Access System Based on C/S Architecture and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information science, the smart system is becoming popular. Hence, this paper conducts the analysis on the telemarketing access system based on C/S architecture and data mining. B/S is far inferior to C/S. Taken together, it can be found that all the strengths of the C/S are the weaknesses of B/S, and vice versa. By using this advantage, the analysis on the CMS is considered. After the OSS processing is successfully returned, the CMS triggers the CDN process, and the CDN process first goes to the CMM. The systematic design shows the robustness of the model.

articleTitle: Smart Obstacle Recognition System using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Blindness is a major problem in the society which made difficult for the person to lead his/her day-to-day life. The proposed system will detect, track and analyze the approaching objects and alert them to avoid collision. The PI camera and the Ultrasonic sensor sense the type and distance between the person and the object. The contactless temperature sensor senses the temperature of the object contactless manner using infrared rays. The GPS sensor tracks the route and location of the blind and the ESP8266 connects with the cloud for Realtime monitoring of the blind. The Vibrating motor and the buzzer alert the person when the safety limit is exceeded. The proposed system uses Raspberry Pi and Arduino Uno microcontroller. The beeping and the vibration are varied according to the distance and temperature of the object. This proposed system will make the life of blind less difficult.

articleTitle: GIS-Assisted Urban Planning System based on Urban Edge Data Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In recent years, the speed of urban development is faster and faster. With the acceleration of urbanization, the nature of land use and planning layout of urban planning area have changed dramatically. This leads to a rapid increase in the amount of urban construction information, and the efficiency of information processing and transmission. Urban planning approval is the core content of urban planning management, which directly affects urban construction and land development mode. The contents of road network analysis, demolition analysis and sunshine analysis in the urban planning system can not be fully displayed in the traditional two-dimensional GIS, so the system can not provi de a reliable basis for planning decision-makers. This paper presents a three-dimensional spatial analysis system for urban planning, which inherits the characteristics of three-dimensional GIS. At the same time, the system can analyze 3D data effectively. The system makes a full study of the more important aspects of urban planning, such as space measurement, demolition management, sunshine analysis, road network planning analysis, etc., and can analyze and audit the planning results.

articleTitle: Sustainable intelligent guiding and diversified integration under the background of data modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: At present, with the gradual application of information technology, manufacturing industry is experiencing a round of technological innovation. As a regional industrial park, many enterprises are faced with the opportunity of transformation. Because of their small scale, these enterprises are short of manufacturing resources, professional talents and knowledge. The emergence of manufacturing service platform can integrate resources from different channels, provide enterprises with services such as production, design and intellectual support, and improve manufacturing efficiency. Based on a brief analysis of the connotation of knowledge fusion and transformation in complex problem solving and the demand for collaborative innovation, this paper proposes a metaphor cognitive strategy and cognitive method of multiple integration according to its characteristics, and designs a data modeling method based on intelligent guidance and multiple theory. Based on the traffic intelligent guidance system, this paper uses Proteus Software to simulate and test some modules, including data acquisition module, time display module and indicator module, and uses electronic components and related materials to make each module and model.

articleTitle: Teaching-Learning Based Optimization of Dual Watermarking of Color Images
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Digital watermarking has proven to be a promising solution for copyright protection. However, several issues relating to robustness and tampered area detection remain unresolved. In this article, two watermarks are embedded in a color image. Using the Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), a gray-scale image is embedded as one of the watermarks for ownership identification. The least significant bit approach is used to embed a binary watermark to locate the tampers. Teaching Learning Based Optimization (TLBO) is employed to boost the watermark's robustness. A new fitness function is proposed for color image watermarking. This technique is tested on both standard and medical images. The performance of this method is evaluated in terms of imperceptibility, robustness, and embedding capacity.

articleTitle: Implementation of Online Guiding System Based on VR and Face Recognition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Implementation of online guiding system based on VR and face recognition algorithms is studied in this paper. The smart online guiding system based on mobile learning concept conforms to the general trend of education informatization and can help schools improve the accuracy of resource planning, resource co-construction, and teaching supervision. To de this, this paper integrates the VR and face recognition. For the VR, it integrates the computer-generated virtual environment with the real environment around the user by means of the photoelectric display technolog which can improve the user experience. For the face recognition, this technology can help to estimate the overall systematic efficiency. The experiment compared with the latest systems proves that the proposed one can improve the efficiency.

articleTitle: Interface Entity based Architecture for Efficient Query Processing in Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In Mobile computing environment, the distributed approach of the system faces the commonly occurred limitations like disconnections caused due to mobility, low bandwidth of wireless channels, restricted battery power and lack of consistent stable storage on mobile nodes which results in bad performance of mobile computing applications. While implementing query processing system in mobile environment it is necessary to consider related issues that may delay the processing. It is needed to process the query based on the current location of the mobile device. It is needful to handle it energy efficiently. The use of Interface Entity proves helpful for designing intelligent query processing architecture where the proposed query processing technique is one of the techniques in which the caching data at Interface Entity proved as a powerful mechanism. It can provide fault tolerance by improving performance of query processing. The caching is applied for frequently accessed data at the mobile clients. Thus caching improves the efficiency and reliability of data delivery over the network. The IQPA proves to be suitable for less as well as large number of nodes in terms of improved throughput, packet delivery ratio and less packet loss.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of high-temperature superconductivity and artificial intelligence-assisted visual analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Numerical simulation of the high-temperature superconductivity and the artificial intelligence-assisted visual analysis is conducted in this paper. High-temperature superconducting power technology is a high-tech technology developed in recent decades. It has very important significance and the development prospects in many fields. To better visualize the testing performance, Artificial Intelligence [AI] has been applied and the data mining models are incorporated to construct the efficient numerical simulation platform. The system is implemented and tested based on the data, and the efficient is validated. Compared with the novel methods, the proposed framework can reflect the test results with interactives.

articleTitle: Development of traditional Chinese medicine culture based on database construction and massive data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Development of the traditional Chinese medicine culture based on database construction and massive data mining is studied in this paper. The main aim of this research work is to design the systematic model, in the case of heavy computing tasks, where the system will generate a large amount of random reads and writes, so the cache system requires to withstand high concurrent requests in a short time, which is the key to improving performance. Based on the designed system, the massive data model is combined with the complex database to automatically analyze the Chinese medicine culture index model. The experiment has been arranged to validate the performance.

articleTitle: Construction of Data Integrated Green Building Evaluation System Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Construction of the integrated green building evaluation system based on BIM technology is studied in this paper. The horizontal is the architectural ecosystem involving buildings, urban power grids, household equipment, and also networked urban environments. For the comprehensive efficient evaluation, we use the BIM to assiste the modelling. Besides, we adopt the advantages of the IoT and the data processing model to construct the efficient items. The experimental results compared with the other state-of-the-art models have proven the results.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey on the use of Fuzzy Graph Structures in India’s Smart City Development
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The notion of smart cities have captivated the imaginations of people, when the whole world has undergone one of the worst economic downturns in the history. The development of Smart City is the key ingredient for shaping sustainable urbanization in India. In the year 2015, this mission was launched in India to improve the quality of human lives and also intensify their experience with urban environment. The study of urban infrastructure growth has begun in the year 2016 with the goal to find an intellectual solution for sustainable cities. The objective is to systematically review and examine the problems raised due to India's smart city development, which has been further progressed by using Fuzzy Graph Structures (FGS). The main aim of this review is to undertake a survey by focusing on the different research studies to encourage a dependable urban planning that bring forth nucleus framework and provides smart result for safe and sustainable environment.

articleTitle: Improved Execution of the BLDC Motor using 3- Phase Conduction Mode for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Electric vehicles are the best answer for green transportation because of their high productivity and zero ozone depleting substance discharges. Different electric motors have been utilized as the drive arrangement of electric vehicles. Execution of brushed Direct Current (DC) motors, acceptance motors, exchanged hesitance motors, and perpetual magnet Brushless DC (BLDC) motors are contrasted agreeing with the in-wheel motor innovation prerequisites under ordinary and basic conditions through re-enactment. This investigation shows that BLDC motors are the most appropriate electric motor for the superior electric vehicles. Direct torque control strategy is a sort of transition linkage based sensorless control strategies in the Brushless DC motors. In this theory, DTC exchanging procedure of the BLDC motor is talked about. Aftereffects of this examination show compelling torque control, decrease of torque swells and improved execution of the BLDC motor contrasted with the traditional exchanging control procedures.
